title: Parting Words
label: ch:russian-parting-words
canDo: I can close a Russian conversation with the parting word that fits how long until I see the person again, and say good night.

payoff.summary: The chapter closes on спокойной ночи, the last word of the day and the surest cognate in the chapter: the reader produces all six parting words in order, names ночь and покой's English cousins, and hears the до + genitive pattern that links five of the six. It is the first realization of SPINE-TAKE-LEAVE in this track, closing all six of the node's concepts, and it reaches back to Chapter 6 to rescue ф, х, чай, хлеб and the request pattern, nothing had revisited since.
